summary: The user wants an offline-capable, browser-only hostel expense splitting web application for 30-50 people with no login, private personal balances, a shared overall debt screen, admin expense deletion capabilities, and automated WhatsApp reminders for debts exceeding ₹500.

contradictions.quoteA: Everything should be saved in the browser only
contradictions.quoteB: There should be one total screen where everyone can see who owes whom.
contradictions.why: If data is stored strictly in one local browser without a database or network sync, expenses added by individual floor members cannot be shared across 30 to 50 separate devices to populate a shared total screen.

contradictions.quoteB: No login: keep it super simple.
contradictions.why: Restricting visibility so each user can only view their own balance requires a user identity mechanism, which is precluded by having no login system.

contradictions.quoteA: I want the admin of the floor to be able to delete wrong expenses.
contradictions.quoteB: No login: keep it super simple.
contradictions.why: Restricting deletion rights exclusively to an admin requires user identification and authorization roles, which conflicts directly with allowing anonymous access without login.

contradictions.quoteA: The app should send a WhatsApp reminder to people who owe more than ₹500.
contradictions.why: Sending WhatsApp messages automatically requires network connectivity and external messaging APIs, which cannot function entirely offline without network access.

contradictions.quoteB: There should be one total screen where everyone can see who owes whom.
contradictions.why: Enforcing strict privacy where no one else can see an individual's balance directly conflicts with displaying a floor-wide total screen showing everyone who owes whom.

missingDecisions.whyItMatters: The system needs to define whether WhatsApp messages are sent via background automated APIs or by triggering wa.me deep links on user devices, as well as how phone numbers are collected.
Without a backend database, implementers must decide how expense data is transferred between devices (such as manual JSON file export/import or P2P WebRTC sync).
Because full authentication is rejected, a lightweight privilege model (like a local floor PIN or admin key) is needed to authorize deleting expenses.
The transcript specifies tracking who owes whom but does not define how roommate payments and balance settlements are recorded or cleared.
Splitting odd expense amounts across up to 50 people produces fractional currency values, requiring defined rounding rules.

questions.question: How should expense data be shared among floor members if no database is used?
options: Use manual JSON or QR code export/import between devices
Introduce a lightweight backend database for real-time synchronization
Run the application on a single shared physical device kept on the floor

questions.question: How should user identity and admin permissions be managed without a login system?
options: Use local passcode/PIN entry to switch user and admin profiles
Select names from a public dropdown with a shared admin password for deletions
Implement basic login accounts with identity-based permissions

questions.question: How should WhatsApp reminders be dispatched while respecting offline constraints?
options: Generate a wa.me pre-filled link that opens WhatsApp on the user's phone
Use a cloud messaging server to send automated WhatsApp messages when online
Display on-screen reminder alerts prompting the user to send manual messages

questions.question: How should balance privacy be reconciled with the total screen showing who owes whom?
options: Display all balances publicly on the total screen for full transparency
Show total net balances on the summary screen but mask detailed breakdown per person
Require user PIN entry before revealing individual balance details

questions.question: How should member settlements and payments be recorded in the system?
options: Allow users to log explicit settlement payment transactions
Mark whole expenses as resolved to clear debts
Recalculate balances only when wrong expenses are deleted by an admin
